notes.title: Prerelease Update
notes.notes:
This is going to be the final update before release. I have a barebones version of the single player campaign but it is only if you select Azrael for the time being. I'm going to patch it up after release and keep adding content to this mode. I also removed the information section for now. I will continue to patch this up as well, adding tutorials, in-depth character bios, and lore. All of this can be done after the release of the game.

As it stands now, the game itself is in a very stable and well-balanced condition. However, I received a negative review that pointed out something interesting to me that I'd like to share. He was complaining that Shen was overpowered, which seemed ridiculous to me because he was always underpowered in the original game. As it turns out, he was absolutely right. 

All of the recent changes made to the core functions of the game, all of it somehow benefitted Shen significantly. So I gave him (and all of the other plain human characters) extreme nerfs in order to balance them out. Shen, Hera, Li, Long, and Tori all have half the amount of stat increases as they level up. Shen and Long also have significantly decreased defenses, making the two seem very "glass cannon"-ish. So now, even at high levels, these characters just aren't as powerful as they used to be, which reflects their "mere mortal" type of limitations. 

I also added new animations for Rock's forward smash and down smash. All players now have a white line around them, which I think makes the game look really sharp. This used to be something that was applied to the current most powerful player in the fight, but now the effect is on everyone all of the time. The most powerful player now strobes and glows a lot in order to let everyone know he's the strongest. 

Thank you very much for all of your support throughout the years. If you really want to show your support, a good review really helps me out a lot. I will try my best to keep patching and updating the game. I'm basically handling it all solo, I hope you understand if it takes me a little while. I look forward to adding more and more features! Take care!

Nick

notes.title: Major Update - New Stages
notes.notes:
This update adds 5 new stages on the bottom row of the stage select. This also fixes a bug where players would clip through ceilings or solid objects.

It also adds a lot of new animations, attacks, and tweaks to Hazel. Her air down smash now does a flip and spikes the enemies down. It is harder to land and does slightly more damage. Her air tilts have new animations and a bit of travel on them as well. 

I also fixed single player. You can try an early version of it if you pick Azrael. You will see new cutscenes and dialogue. It should all be fixed and working now.

Thanks for playing! I am trying to finish this game up soon, thanks for you support.

Nick

notes.title: New Year's Update
notes.notes:
This update fixes a lot of bugs, mostly ones introduced with the last update which included Team and Stock modes, along with player handicaps.

There is also a new stage, which is essentially a fortress. I will continue to patch in a few more as time goes on. I'm working hard on finishing the game up and doing a full release soon. Currently, the information section is still a work in progress, so a lot of it is shut off for now. I will finish this soon and patch it up in the next update.

notes.title: Major Christmas Update.
notes.notes:
This update features a lot of new content. Single Player now has a bit of dialogue when you choose Azrael. With each update I will continue to improve the single player campaign experience with more cut scene type of sequences, and add dialogue for each and every character. Single Player is also easier overall now with more continues being made available per mode. Hard mode now offers up to 3 continues instead of just one, for example. Easy Mode has also been made *extremely* easy for newcomers. A generic soldier fighter has been added in the campaign mode as well.

Team Mode has also been added into the game. The controller can now use the Y button (Triangle Button on Playstation) to cycle through teams. Same for the player colors. Hovering the cursor over the name and clicking it will also change the teams, you'll see the name of the character change color. If everyone is on a different color, it automatically creates a FFA game. If there's more than one person with the same color, then it automatically makes it a team game. During a team game everyone on the same team will have matching colored auras.

Stock Mode has also been added. The game up until now has been a race to a KO limit, or a frag limit. With the addition of Stock Mode, it becomes a last man standing battle like Super Smash Bros. If you hover the cursor over the very top of the screen during the player select, you'll be able to click to switch between modes.

Handicap has also been added. You need to venture into the options menu in order to turn it on. The options have also been revamped. Once you turn it on, hover the cursor over the handicap and adjust it from 1 to 10, 10 being normal and 1 being a tenth of the fighter. Each number is a factor of 10, so if you set it to 5 then you are 50% as powerful. The lower the number is, the less damage and knockback you do, and the more knockback you receive.

In addition to other preset modes such as Quick Match and Normal Match, there is now an even faster mode called Lightning Match, which is only 3 KOs/Stock. All of the time limits have been slightly reduced for all of the preset modes as well. 

Instead of it saying CPU Level 1-5, it now reads as follows: 
Level 1 is now Easy Bot.
Level 2 is now Normal Bot.
Level 3 is now Hard Bot.
Level 4 is now Insane Bot.
And Level 5 is Nightmare.

The HUD has also had an overhaul. It has been made super simple, displaying only the colored health and stamina bars and your KO/Stock amount. If you press the select button, it will switch it back to the way that it used to be. If you keep pressing select, it will display all of your stats overall. A simpler to read HUD makes it a lot easier for newcomers to jump into the game without being overwhelmed. The color of the stamina bar is now the same beige type of color for everyone, but the health bar corresponds to the team you are on.

Hazel also has a new ground Forward Smash animation. Spark effects are also bigger with Medium Attacks (Tilts) and even bigger with Heavy Attacks (Smashes) and clashes. The camera has also been slightly adjusted for each stage.

In future updates I will be adding more dialogue/campaigns for every character. I will also add tutorials and bios soon as well. I'm trying to finish up and fully release the game very soon. I hope everyone enjoys all of the new game changing content in this end of the year update, and that you are having a Merry Christmas and a Happy Holidays!

Nick

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: This update adds more new graphics and tweaks to Hazel, most notably her forward air smash attack which sends her spinning through the air. Minor adjustments to this character as well as Single Player were made.

notes.title: Another Big Update
notes.notes:
After 6 months, I've finally finished updating all of the sprites and animation for Samael. He now has much cleaner looking graphics and animations overall. He also has an Ascended form that activates over level 24 when your stamina and health are low.

I'm also currently working on updating Hazel. In this patch, she has a better run, jump, and double jump animation. Much more are coming soon. She also has a lot of minor buffs overall.

She has more roll and air dodge distance, more natural stamina regeneration, and a much faster power-up stamina regeneration as well. Her grab lunges her forward a bit, is open longer, and she has rapid hits that deal minor damage when she grabs an opponent. Her Air Smashes deactivate her flight, and her Air Up Smash pushes her up a little bit as she strikes, and a little more if the attack connects. 

She also now has a counter, which can be activated by holding block and pressing the heavy attack button. (The top one, triangle on Playstation and Y on Xbox gamepads). If she is hit during this time, she will block it and immediately do a counter attack like all of the other blade wielding characters. 

If you have any issues with visuals, save files, or any other sort of weird bug, then it might be due to changes in the save file function. You will have to go to C:\Users\(Your name here)\AppData\Local\Shadow_of_Azrael_2 and then either move or delete the .dat and .sav save files that exist there. That should fix any major problems you have. 

Thanks again for all of your support. Much more to come, still working on the tutorial. I have it all written out and I will copy and paste it over and implement it in the next patch. If there is anything you don't like, or any bugs that you find, please don't write a nasty review. We are still in early access, just write any complaints in the forum and I will address everything in time. If you like the game, please leave us a good review.

Thanks again. Have a good weekend!
Nick

notes.title: Massive Update!
notes.notes:
This is the first update and it's pretty huge. Please bare in mind that I'm practically a solo developer doing all of this on my own.

First of all, the game now prompts you on the first startup to choose your operating system; Windows or Linux. By doing this, it fixes the game for people who are running it on Linux or Steam Deck. Before this update, it would only work on Windows. Once you've selected it the first time around, it never asks you again, but you can still change it in the options menu.

3 new songs were also added. Also, Samael's sprites are being completely redone. I'm about 75% finished with his new sprites.

All characters have been made available from the start in the early access version.

Weight is a bigger factor in throw distance now. Ravenous's grabs have also been slightly nerfed.

The pickup range for items is now slightly greater.

There is a new attack speed variable in the script. Once a player hits a pivotal level (24, 48, 64, 80, 96) the speed of their attacks slightly increase.

Shadow Clones of each character can be accessed by holding down the button on the player select portrait. Shadow Clones essentially turn any character into a glass cannon version of themselves. All of their stats, such as their speed and strength, are slightly improved. The big drawback, however, is that they now have half health as well. This doesn't necessarily make them better than the original versions, it's just something fun and different to play around with. Each character has a unique feature when it comes to their shadow clone counter part.

In the next update, I will include a guide that details all of the mechanics, tutorials, and details involved with Shadow Clones and everything else.

So far, I have only one review and it is negative. However, I'd like to point out that the same person left me a bad review on the first game and I fixed all of his complaints in the following patch. If there are any issues you are having with the game, I'd prefer that you leave feedback in the forums so that I can address them instead of leaving me a negative review. I'm just one developer. I'd also appreciate any positive reviews because it helps me out a lot.

In future updates I will add better guides, tutorials, and instructions in the menus. I will also add a story, more lore, more character bios, and more to single player. 

Thank you for all of your support.
Nick
